div.head: Episc 14
div.ab: Et omnes sumus Dei necessario-serui; et sic iudicabit nobis, sicut ante iudicauimus eis, quibus in terris iudicium superhabebimus.
Ealle we syndon Godes ágene nydþeowan; ⁊ swa he gedemð ús, swa we her demað þam þe we on eorðan dom ofer ágan.
Ealle we syndon Godes agene nydþeowan; and swa he gedemð us, swa we her demað þam þe we on eorðan dom ofer agan.
Alle sind wir Gottes eigene Knechte; und er wird uns so richten, wie wir hienieden die richten, über die wir auf Erden Verfügung [Rechtsprechung] besitzen.
We are all God's own slaves; and he will judge us as we here judge those over whom we have authority [jurisdiction] on earth.
We are all God’s own slaves, and he judges us just as we judge those over whom we hold power here on earth.
